blurb: Guests can join various fishing and cruising trips including kid friendly fishing, back bay flounder fishing, sunset or booze cruises, and striper fishing. Trips range from 2 to 5 hours and are designed for fun and catching fish. Paddleboard rentals are also available for 1 to 5 days.
